message.content:
A magazine cover for "TEMPO" displays a crowded outdoor scene. In the foreground, a woman wearing a purple headscarf and a two-toned orange and purple shirt points her finger toward a person in a tan uniform, whose back and side of the head are visible in the lower right. The woman has an intense facial expression. Behind her, a dense crowd of people, mostly young men, look on; some hold up smartphones to record. To the left, a man in a black t-shirt with "234 SC" and a wing logo stands near the woman.

Large white text "TEMPO" is centered at the top. Above it, text reads "Yaqut Cholil dalam Pusaran Korupsi Haji H.28" and "Terjepit Beban Utang Kereta Cepat H.78". Lower left text reads "BISUL PECAH KEMARAHAN PUBLIK," followed by a paragraph starting with "Demonstrasi besar menuntut pembubaran..." and ending with "H.62". The bottom right shows "1-7 SEPTEMBER 2025," a price "RP 60.000," website information, an ISSN, a barcode, and a QR code. The background is filled with protesters and flags.
